scope: Evacuate Snowmane (42088): code/data audit and repair. Client testing explicitly deferred by the user.
findings: The three gossip handlers previously granted immediate credits through unguarded SmartAI lists. Red and Tarvim never picked up their native carry auras or moved. Tarvim had a corrupt fallback text and no BroadcastTextID.

C++ validates the exact resident/menu/option, active incomplete quest, unfinished resident objective, live nearby same-phase visible NPC and line of sight. SQL suppresses already-used options. Condition 41 uses ObjectID in this core, not the quest_objectives row ID.

Red and Tarvim each summon a private non-interactive actor. Only its owner sees it; the public source is hidden only from that player. Native pickup aura 210246 or 210304 and a successful ground spline launch precede the corresponding credit. Duplicate clicks cannot start a second scene.
Old Nefu replies and stays in his home. He deliberately has no escape path; the native quest still labels his conversation as an evacuation objective. His existing aura 130966 is preserved.

Source visibility and unfinished scenes recover after a failed spawn/aura/spline, quest abandon/reaccept, death, logout, map/phase/range departure or timeout. The last objective completing the quest does not cancel an already-running departure.

All three original TDB735 objectives remain unchanged: 283606 / ObjectID 106115, 283617 / 106153, 283622 / 106191, each amount 1. Mayla 93846 remains the live starter and native/live ender. The original TDB has no starter relation for 42088; no claim that its live starter came from that archive.

The quest uses intact terrain 1532. PathGenerator currently selects base map 1220 and does not account for terrain phasing. Base-map nearest ground differs by about +9 m for Red and -11 m for Tarvim. Local linear departure routes use the installed intact-terrain navmesh with height samples. No global pathfinding behavior was changed.

The base BroadcastText.db2 lacks all four relevant IDs. Runtime SQL hotfix rows 109069/109076/109086/109107 have VerifiedBuild 26124. Corrected creature_text fallbacks match those rows; Tarvim now references 109086.

It substitutes actual source spawn height for the first point, matching MoveSplineInit. Maximum accepted horizontal ground offset 0.08 m and height difference 0.65 m.
Test-HighmountainEvacuationNative.py passes against original TDB735 and installed DB2 files.

Stopped-server deployment completed with scoped SQL backups, transaction and updater hash registration. Live evacuation and previous Snowblind parallel data tests pass.

Release worldserver and bnetserver compile successfully in build-extractors/bin/Release. worldserver --version succeeds (6ff334a7157d+ working-tree build). Runtime configuration, certificates, DLLs, logs and extracted data are preserved.

deployment.method: Scoped backups; stopped worldserver; InnoDB transaction and RELEASED updater registration. Server remains stopped.

limits: No in-game verification. Client retest must confirm Kaya/two-brave carry visuals, actor/source visibility for two players, both departures, Nefu remaining in his hut and the Mayla turn-in.

The short departure routes, 2-second reaction delay, personal cloning and 45-second summon limit are bounded server reconstruction, not verified retail choreography. Static background warbraves are not removed without evidence identifying the exact wounded actors.
Navmesh checks establish installed ground geometry, not client animation or decorative-model rendering. The next Highmountain Stands destruction sequence is outside this change.
